require 'open3'

def safe_convert_command(image_paths, target_size, delay, append_reverted, output_path)
  sanitized_paths = image_paths.map { |path| Shellwords.escape(path) }
  sanitized_output = Shellwords.escape(output_path)
  command = ["convert", "-delay", delay.to_s, "-resize", target_size, *sanitized_paths]
  command += ["-reverse", *sanitized_paths] if append_reverted
  command << sanitized_output
  stdout, stderr, status = Open3.capture3(*command)
  raise "Command failed: #{stderr}" unless status.success?
